findings.finding: Both services create simulated fills; neither inspected execution path sends venue orders.
BTC REST full-response local freshness is not continuous exchange quote freshness.
ETH40 uses per-symbol locally checksum-verified WebSocket books, local/exchange freshness <=5000ms, exchange future allowance <=1000ms; rules age <=1day.
Shared planner walks displayed eligible depth; 10bp best-executable-price collar, 5% displayed-depth cap, tick/lot/minimum and fee-inclusive budget checks. It does not simulate queue competition.
BTC durable paper intent settles locally, expires after30s, and can finish CANCELED with retained partial inventory. Synthetic acceptance/cancellation is not venue reconciliation.
BTC pending buy is rechecked for current entry policy; pending sell is not subject to that buy-only invalidation condition.
ETH40 first60sec UTC execution window and at-most-one-fill/account/day must not silently become passive then partial top-up. A maker fallback after partial entry is a new experiment.
WAITING/HOLD does not certify executable market data; per-asset quotes/rules must be inspected independently.
Cash/receipt replay and exact duplicate handling protect paper balances. Marking full inventory at best bid less exit fee is not executable full-depth liquidation proof.
Deployed BTC $100000 account and ETH40 $10000 accounts have different allocation rules; raw P&L does not isolate execution quality.
